{{Top}}
[[File:Repulsorcraft_with_Pilot_Droid.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Repulsorcraft with [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] at [[Kuat Passenger Port]]]]

A '''repulsorcraft''' was any ground vehicle that hovered and moved via an [[Gravity/Legends|antigravity]] [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]].

Vehicles that commonly employed repulsors include [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bikes]], [[Swoop/Legends|swoops]], [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeders]], [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeders]], [[skimmer/Legends|skimmers]] and various [[flier]]s.

All repulsorcraft were unable to penetrate [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]].<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> Like treaded craft, they were also unable to climb fortyfive-degree slopes.<ref name="Star Wars: Rogue Squadron: The Official Nintendo Player's Guide">''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron: The Official Nintendo Player's Guide]]''</ref>
